title: ETVW
description: ETVW is a crazy mod that adds things according to Vihaan7_8 liking!
body:
![Potion with Vihaan7-8 above it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf43c0423466a67370351c04ccf600725b98e8e0_0.webp)

🌟 ETVW: Everything to the Developer's Liking!
ETVW is a wild, fun, and ever-expanding mod that adds a mix of useful items, powerful tools, and quirky features—all driven by the whims and creativity of the developer! If you're looking for unique mechanics and surprising additions, this is the mod for you.

✨ Mod Features
New Consumables
Milk Bottles: A handy, portable alternative to a bucket of milk.

Powerful Gear
Speedy Gem: A rare, deep-level ore. When Licked (Right-Clicked), the gem grants the player Speed II for 10 seconds! Perfect for quick escapes and travel.

Unique Utility
The Creative Utilities Menu: Access a little Utility Menu for stuff like Speed and Legendary Tier Equipment!

And Much More!
Expanding Content: We are constantly adding new blocks, items, tools, and fun surprises to make the world more interesting!

💎 Get Started
To start your journey with ETVW, seek out the incredibly useful Speedy Gem deep underground!

🎥 Mod Showcase
Check out the official showcase video to see ETVW's features in action!
